dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, your results are interesting, but you don't emphasize your key points.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, jʊr rɪˈzʌlts ər ˈɪntrəstɪŋ, bʌt juː ˈdoʊnt ˈɛmfəsaɪz jʊr ˈkiː ˈpɔɪnts.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I do emphasize them! I say "This is important" every time.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈduː ˈɛmfəsaɪz ðɛm! aɪ ˈseɪ ðɪs ɪz ɪmˈpɔːrtənt ˈɛvri ˈtaɪm.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: You do say it, but you say it very quickly.
dialogue.reading: juː ˈduː ˈseɪ ɪt, bʌt juː ˈseɪ ɪt ˈvɛri ˈkwɪkli.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh. So how can I make my key points clearer?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ. soʊ ˈhaʊ kən aɪ ˈmeɪk maɪ ˈkiː ˈpɔɪnts ˈklɪrər?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Slow down, and say each one again at the end.
dialogue.reading: ˈsloʊ ˈdaʊn, ənd ˈseɪ ˈiːtʃ ˈwʌn əˈɡɛn ət ði ˈɛnd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. My most significant result is that students do want to speak more English. They just don't have chances.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. maɪ ˈmoʊst sɪɡˈnɪfɪkənt rɪˈzʌlt ɪz ðæt ˈstuːdənts ˈduː ˈwɑːnt tə ˈspiːk ˈmɔːr ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ. ðeɪ ˈdʒʌst ˈdoʊnt ˈhæv ˈtʃænsɪz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's a crucial point. Why didn't you mention it earlier?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ə ˈkruːʃəl ˈpɔɪnt. ˈwaɪ ˈdɪdənt juː ˈmɛnʃən ɪt ˈɜːrliər?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I did mention it! It's on slide six.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈdɪd ˈmɛnʃən ɪt! ɪts ɑːn ˈslaɪd ˈsɪks.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: It's essential to put it at the start, too. Some people will stop listening by slide six!
dialogue.reading: ɪts ɪˈsɛnʃəl tə ˈpʊt ɪt ət ðə ˈstɑːrt, ˈtuː. sʌm ˈpiːpəl wɪl ˈstɑːp ˈlɪsənɪŋ baɪ ˈslaɪd ˈsɪks!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Ha! True. Do I need more examples?
dialogue.reading: ˈhɑː! ˈtruː. duː aɪ ˈniːd ˈmɔːr ɪɡˈzæmpəlz?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: You do need one or two. A short story from a real student would be great.
dialogue.reading: juː ˈduː ˈniːd ˈwʌn ɔːr ˈtuː. ə ˈʃɔːrt ˈstɔːri frəm ə ˈriːəl ˈstuːdənt wʊd bi ˈɡreɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I did interview some students. I'll use one of their stories.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈdɪd ˈɪntərvjuː sʌm ˈstuːdənts. aɪl ˈjuːz ˈwʌn əv ðɛr ˈstɔːriz.
